title: Lane Receipt
description: Structured lane receipt for strata fleet waves (E51/C1). Replaces free-prose entries in docs/waves/WAVES_3_9.md.

lane.description: Lane id, e.g. L150, E31, or W4-P12.

status.description: Standing vocabulary; PENDING/RUNNING are pre-receipt states and are not valid on a receipt.

owned_files.description: Files the lane owned per the lane map. Paths are repo-relative.

disclosed_touches.description: Files touched outside owned_files (compile-freeze SLA unblocks, seams), each disclosed.

output_digest.description: sha256 of the verification command output.

deviations.description: Typed deviations: honest misses, coordinator rulings, superseded entries, disclosed touches.

fix_owner.description: Lane responsible for an open finding, if any.

$comment: finished_at >= started_at is enforced by the validator (structurally), not by JSON Schema.
